evals.name: saves raw data and records provenance
evals.prompt: Download this week's orders export from the metrics API and tell me the total revenue.
evals.expected_output: Saves the raw response to disk before parsing and records where it came from, then computes the total.
assertions: The response saves the raw fetched data before parsing it.
The response records provenance — the source URL, the time fetched, or an equivalent note.
